home.heroTitle: Premium Eggs, Delivered Fresh Every Day
home.heroSubtitle: Agroprime supplies carefully graded, farm-fresh eggs to retailers, wholesalers, and exporters across Qatar, backed by strict quality control and reliable cold-chain delivery.
home.why1Desc: Every batch moves through an unbroken cold chain from farm to shelf, so freshness is never compromised.
home.why2Desc: Every egg is sized, weighed, and graded to consistent standards before it reaches your shelves.
home.why3Desc: Consistent volume and on-time delivery for retail, wholesale, and export orders, day after day.
home.categoriesSubtitle: One product, done right — graded, sized, and packaged to meet retail, wholesale, and export standards.
home.ctaSubtitle: Get in touch with our team for retail, wholesale, or bulk export pricing.

about.title: About Agroprime
about.intro: Agroprime is a Qatar-based egg producer and trading company, supplying fresh, quality-graded eggs to retail and wholesale partners across the region.
about.storyBody: Founded to bring consistently fresh, reliably graded eggs to Qatar's retail and food service markets, Agroprime has built its reputation one delivery at a time — on freshness, honesty in grading, and showing up on schedule.
about.missionBody: To deliver fresh, high-quality eggs efficiently and reliably, building long-term partnerships based on trust.
about.visionBody: To become the most trusted egg supplier in Qatar and the wider Gulf region.
about.value3: Reliability our partners can count on

products.title: Our Eggs
